historical_record.description: From about 1989 this building housed a succession of dance halls named Club Townsend, Skirts, Thunderdome, Pleasuredome and Club Universe.
The City Planning Commission certified the final environmental impact report for a mixed-use building with parking, retail, office and live/work spaces.
The City Planning Commission approved as amended the authorization to construct up to 46,775 gross square feet of office use in the new mixed-use building.
The City Planning Commission approved as amended the conditional use for 62 dwelling units, a bulk exception and a planned unit development for the new mixed-use building.
The City Planning Commission approved as amended the staff-initiated discretionary review item for the new mixed-use building.

The City Planning Commission approved a conditional use authorization for a mixed-use Planned Unit Development with 198 dwelling units, about 5,000 square feet of commercial space, and a 201-space garage at 177 Townsend Street.
